notes.recognition: Dense fractured slate reads as the hardest and highest terrain at a glance.
notes.agency: The heavy value mass reinforces movement cost while route feedback stays unobstructed.
notes.specificity: Faint cyan and green mineral inclusions connect natural slate to the Glassroot world.
notes.restraint: Pass B removes the square markings and deep architectural holes present in Pass A.
notes.continuity: Cool stone, weathered grain, and restrained mineral color match the 3D mountain silhouettes.
notes.reusability: Broad fractures remain useful under crops, rotation, and top-material tinting.
notes.accessibility: Strong relief and crack structure distinguish the biome without color.
